_comment: Real books the audit converts. Public-domain scans, CC-licensed and open-access publications only; the PDFs themselves are never committed (see fetch.py). Each entry names the layout family it stands for, so a gap in coverage is visible here. Arabic-script (Ottoman) scans were tried and left out: the app reads Latin and right-to-left Arabic/Hebrew/Persian text layers, not Ottoman OCR.
